title: Model- and Layer-Level Closed-Loop Forecasting with SSM-Based Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.28495v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep State-Space Models (Deep SSMs) have shown promising performance and computational benefits in processing of time-series data with complex temporal dependencies. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) constitute a biologically inspired class of deep SSMs, where computing blocks communicate through spikes, discrete single-bit events rather than continuous activation functions. A particularly important task in time-series processing is forecasting, i.e. predicting future values of a sequence from past observations alone. However, how to best perform forecasting with SNNs is an open question, where the standard autoregressive nature of the data processing with SNNs requires values that are not available during the forecasting phase. translated_title: 基于状态空间模型的脉冲神经网络的模型级与层级闭环预测
translated_abstract: 深度状态空间模型在处理具有复杂时间依赖性的时间序列数据方面展现出了有前景的性能和计算优势。脉冲神经网络是一类受生物学启发的深度状态空间模型，其中计算模块通过脉冲——即离散的单比特事件——而非连续的激活函数进行通信。时间序列处理中一项特别重要的任务是预测，即仅根据过去的观测值来预测序列的未来值。然而，如何最好地使用脉冲神经网络进行预测仍是一个悬而未决的问题，因为脉冲神经网络数据处理的标准自回归特性需要用到在预测阶段无法获得的值。在本文中，我们应对了这一挑战。我们探索了两种闭环预测策略，即将网络自身生成的值反馈到网络中，如同它们是观测到的过去值一样。
tldr: 本文针对脉冲神经网络自回归预测中所需历史值不可用的问题，提出了模型级与层级的闭环预测策略，将网络自身生成的预测值反馈回网络作为输入。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes model- and layer-level closed-loop forecasting strategies for SSM-based spiking neural networks, feeding the network's own generated predictions back as inputs to address the unavailability of required values during autoregressive forecasting.
